metadata.explanation: Task requires researching ACL Best Long Paper Award winners for 2019-2022 and recording complete information. Evaluator extracts all columns (title, year, authors, PDF) from Excel file and verifies: (1) exactly 4 papers recorded, (2) correct years 2019-2022, (3) correct paper titles, (4) authors contain commas and match expected authors, (5) PDF links match expected URLs. Returns weighted score with partial credit for each component.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks ALL requirements from instruction - paper titles, years (2019-2022), authors with comma separation, and PDF links
Correct getter logic: Extracts all 4 columns (title, year, authors, PDF) from Excel file as required
Proper metric comparison: Verifies correct paper count, matches papers by year, checks titles with flexible matching, validates authors contain commas AND match expected names, verifies PDF links
Good partial credit design: Weighted scoring (count=0.25, year=0.20, title=0.25, author=0.20, pdf=0.10) allows fair evaluation of incomplete submissions
Proper postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure data persistence
Expected values appear correct: 4 real ACL award winners with complete data for years 2019-2022
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Author matching uses 50% threshold (line 99 in metrics/xlsx.py:99) - consider raising to 70-80% for stricter validation
Minor: Title matching is very flexible (substring matching) - could allow similar but incorrect titles to pass, though this is reasonable for handling variations
Minor: PDF matching only checks if expected PDF filename appears in result - could be stricter about full URL format, though current approach is practical
